resolver.policy: tools/anim_graph/frontier_bindings.json resolver_policy (one loop for every leaf); leaves where the two loops disagree carry resolution 'ambiguous'

conventions.fade_s: transition scalar +0x1c; crossfade seconds (inferred, not proven; graph_understanding)
conventions.order: record order inside a state; the first record whose request matches and whose conditions hold wins
conventions.conditions: (mode, min, max): mode bit 2 = at least min, bit 1 = at most max; the first condition is the normalized phase of the source state (a first value > 1 is frames at 30 Hz, inferred); later conditions test another variable (see variable)
conventions.scalar_0x20: second duration of unknown purpose (-1 = unset)
conventions.mirror_cb: state +0x2c callback; returns 1 (or a runtime int) to play the tree mirrored. Evidence: 76 trees are shared by a state whose +0x2c returns constant 1 and a state without +0x2c, and the mirrored one is always the left / '-m' / other-hand twin (inferred)
conventions.phase_update_cb: state +0x28 callback returns the new phase (phase + rate*dt, or a value set by code)
conventions.selections: weapon/mode base selections of tools/anim_graph plus 'unarmed' (weapon-base / draw-holster no-weapon sets; Frontier has no unarmed profile, reference only)
conventions.overlay_variants: results under an extra traversal overlay set (ledge / jump / ladder-entry-exit / wall-shimmy / crouch-under) that differ from the base result
conventions.geometry_label: heights / contacts parsed from state and clip names; authoring labels only

vault.description: Vault over an obstacle: the old one-state vault (vault + hashed exit requests), the 1 m / 2 m vault-over chain, and the three-part 'test-vault' chain (begin -> mid -> end) that carries the Actor_B vault clips, including sprint-vault-1..4 under the sprint move overlay.

step_up_carry.description: 0.5 m step-up while carrying an object (carry overlay; listed for completeness).

step_up.description: Step up onto a 0.5 m or 1 m surface without a hand plant (idle / run entries, auto-climb 1 m).

jump_onto.description: Jump onto a surface (short / medium / high, with '-close' variants): run-up -> air (phase driven by code) -> knee or chest landing -> idle / run.

jump_up_ledge.description: Standing / running jump-up to a ledge at 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 3 m: knee (1-1.5 m), chest (2 m, begin-mid-end) or hang (3 m, begin-mid-end then hang-climb-up to knee), then climb-up to idle or run; the 2.75 m fail variants.

ledge_catch.description: Jump or fall to a ledge and catch it: knee / waist / chest / one-hand / two-hand contact, the falling edge grab and the jump-up-from-cover grab; most end in the ledge hang hub (ledge-grab).

wall_jump.description: Run at a wall at 45 or 90 degrees, kick off, and either fail (fall) or long-jump into one of the catch families (requests knee / chest-grab / waist-grab / long / short / high / ledge ...).

drop_to_hang.description: Walk / roll / step off an edge (forwards or backwards) into a hang, or drop from the narrow-ledge shimmy into a hang.

ledge_hang.description: The hang hub (ledge-grab) and its idles: swing fw/bk, look left/right/away/up-back (+fail), continuous shimmy left/right, letting go (ledge-grab-fall) and the water-edge grab.

ledge_climb.description: Hand-over-hand moves between handholds while hanging: up / down / left / right / diagonals, 'far' (jump) variants, 90-degree inside / outside corners, up-back and down-forward, each with a settle state (^idle) that chains into the next move. Under the ledge=ladder overlay the same states play the ladder clips.

hang_reactions.description: Partial / additive reactions while hanging (flinches, throws); started by code, no transitions.

drop_down.description: Run off / drop down 1 m or 2 m and land into idle / run, or drop into the fall loop.

ladder.description: Ladder mount (bottom / top) and dismount (top, bottom). The rungs themselves are the ledge_climb / ledge_hang states under the ledge=ladder overlay (ledge-grab = ladder idle, climb-up-* = rung up, climb-down-* = rung down).

wall_shimmy.description: Standing on a narrow ledge facing the wall and side-stepping (enter / idle / idle^move / move / move^idle / exit, climb-up from a hang).

gap_jump.description: Authored gap jump (2.5 m; 1.5 m and left-foot variants through the jump overlay), jump facing a wall, wall-slide into fall, jump in place.

edge_balance.description: Stopping at an edge (ledge warn fw / bw / l / r) and losing balance at an edge (avoid-fall).

water_edge.description: Running dive into water (ends in swim).
